scope: engineering observability pilot, not a classifier evaluation
selection: First facility by existing ID-sorted manifest in each previously unrepresented fold (0,3,4). No outcome-based selection. Existing 56216/56217/56218 retained.
stop: First acquisition failure or crop SCL clear fraction below 0.9 or total cap; no retries or replacement sites.
catalog: max three requests, two candidates each, 1 MiB response cap; scene cloud <20%, 2024 retained for consistency
scientific_limit: Convenience pilot with one or two facilities per fold; cannot estimate national success or classifier performance.
